title: track_framing
description: Set the framing style tracking uses: close, waist, full or wide. Applies now when tracking is on, and to the next follow.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: The camera's id. May be left out when there is only one camera.

framing.title: Framing
framing.description: close is head and shoulders, waist is from the waist up, full is the whole person, wide is the person and the space around them.
